resources.string: Blurp

Blurp frosts the folding half of your screen while you open and close your phone, everywhere including the lock screen. It only draws a blur on top of the screen. It doesn\'t read, collect or share anything on your screen.
Blurp
To frost your screen while you fold, Blurp draws a blur layer over everything using Android\'s Accessibility service. It doesn\'t read, collect or share anything on your screen.
I understand and allow Blurp to use the Accessibility service
Continue
Turn on Blurp
In the next screen, switch Blurp on. Then come back.
Open Settings
In the next screen, switch Blurp on. Blurp came from a download, so Android answers “App was denied access” the first time: tap Close and come back here.
Android held Blurp back. Open App info, tap ⋮ at the top right and choose “Allow restricted settings”. Then open Settings again and switch Blurp on.
Open App info
Close your phone, then open it
That\'s it. Works everywhere, even on the lock screen.
Skip
You\'re all set
Blurp frosts the half that moves every time you fold, even on the lock screen. It keeps working with the app closed.
Done
